rows.title: Programmable to the core
cells: Every action is an API, every control is code, every workflow composable.
Strong developer tooling is what gives your team velocity and assurance.
Own the UI, keep the customer relationship, delegate the core infrastructure.

rows.title: Deploy anywhere, re-architect never
cells: SaaS, hybrid, or fully self-hosted on one platform, with MPC, HSM, TEE or offline key models underneath.
Custody, key, deployment models and jurisdictions are switchable configuration.
Future-proof operations, built atop infrastructure that adjusts to changing regulation.

rows.title: One platform, not a toolchain
cells: Every component runs as a unified operating system, not stitched-together point tools.
Fragmenting custody, treasury, trading and compliance is how risk and cost creep in.
One control plane, one audit trail, one integration. Fewer seams, fewer places to break.

rows.title: Cryptography you can inspect
cells: MPC libraries built in-house, independently audited, open-sourced to the Linux Foundation.
You verify what secures your assets instead of trusting a licensed black box.
Your auditors and regulators examine the actual code path protecting client keys.
